scientific_limitations_and_integrity: Complete point counts for ordinary pairwise commuting tuples in Der(F_q[t]/(t^p)) and its standard positive-degree filtered subalgebras; not a component/scheme or conjugacy-orbit classification. title: All-arity finite-field commuting counts for the one-variable Witt Lie algebra
